## Description

A person's task, moved out of MDV-P0-023 (it is P0 exit criterion 1) so the design-system epic could close. Decision 12 Nov 2026 (docs/releases/r0.md): the founder approves R0, and the clinician walk-through becomes the pilot entry check, done by the pilot clinic's own doctor; nothing clinical reaches a patient before it. Walk that doctor through J1–J6: the built steps on the Azure India dev environment, the rest on the storyboard. Record sign-off, or change requests with owners, per journey. Do it before the R1 pilot (MDV-P1-042) with at least one sprint left to build what the advisor asks for in the pilot clinic flow.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Clinical advisor sign-off (or a list of requested changes with owners) for each of J1–J6 is recorded in docs/02-design/journeys.md with the date and the advisor's role.
- [ ] **AC2.** Any change requested by the advisor is raised as a ticket in the relevant phase; changes to the pilot clinic flow are scheduled before MDV-P1-042.
- [ ] **AC3.** The P0 exit gate item "Clinical advisor walks all six journeys and signs off" is evidenced.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
